facts.fact: Presidential Decree 60/21 of 10 March 2021, the fee regulation of Angola's data protection agency (APD), lists an act of authorisation for international data transfer at a fee of Kz 350,450, so the APD's permission was a condition for sending personal data abroad; the document gives no date of effect other than its publication date, 2021-03-10.
facts.system: Regulamento das Taxas da Agência de Protecção de Dados (Tabela de Taxas da APD, item 1.7 Transferência internacional de dados)

note: Fee table for APD authorisations; the fee table, not guidance or a list of countries, so no fact on means or application.
